name: – After § 17 – Am 1
title: People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
part_text: 17a. Welcomes initiatives undertaken by Taiwanese and other companies to invest in semiconductor fabrication plants in Member States and recognises these efforts as crucial steps to strengthen the semiconductor supply chain for the EU; calls on the Member States to pursue these investments to ensure European strategic autonomy;
